resources.string: A little movement. A little you-time.
Gentle movement. Right from your living room.
Use the arrows to explore. Select to choose. Back to return.
A softer start. A moment for you.
Preview catalogue • Sessions await professional review and licensed media.
If you feel like it, there is time for a gentle session. There is no schedule to keep.
Nothing here yet. Try a different duration or position, or save a favourite from Gentle sessions.

This session is a planning placeholder. It has no approved exercise instructions, narration or video yet. Playback is unavailable until a qualified exercise professional has reviewed it and media rights are recorded.

Choose a clear, comfortable space. If using a chair, use a stable chair without wheels. Move at a pace that feels comfortable and stop if you feel unwell or uncomfortable. If you are unsure whether a session is suitable for you, seek advice from a qualified professional.
This general information needs professional review before release. We will remember your acknowledgement on this device.
Technical audio test only. No exercise instruction. This does not count towards workout progress.
Your session has been saved on this device. Take your time before choosing what comes next.
Four weeks, at your own pace. Programme content is not available yet.
Membership is not available in this preview. You will not be charged. Free starter sessions will not require a subscription.
Proposed UK test offers: £4.99 monthly or £29.99 annually. These are planning prices, not live purchase offers.

Release disclosure draft: subscriptions renew automatically at the Amazon-displayed price until cancelled. Manage renewal through your Amazon account. Final terms, billing period and cancellation wording require review before sale.
Restoring purchases is not available in this preview. No payment or membership has been changed.
Your completed sessions will appear here. You can return whenever it suits you. Drafts and playback tests are not counted.
With permission, help choose comfortable settings. Changes are saved on this television. There is no remote monitoring.
French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch are prepared for translation review. English is used until reviewed translations are available.
Your preferences, favourites and progress stay on this device. No diagnoses, tracking, analytics uploads or accounts are collected. Delete local data whenever you choose.

Would you like someone you trust to help with settings? Continue only with your permission. They can adjust text, captions, speed and preferences here. Nothing is shared and nobody can monitor you remotely.
